llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad domain description is real, but it is coherent with a general workflow orchestration API and is balanced by explicit external API notice and first-call disclosure safeguards, so it does not justify Review by itself.
[SQP-3] unexpected: The hard-coded Greek language parameter in one example is an instruction-quality issue that could surprise users if reused verbatim, but English is documented as the default and this is not a material security concern.
llm.guidance: Install this only if you are comfortable sending the flow code and query text you provide to api.neurodoc.app. Avoid including passwords, personal data, private files, credentials, or confidential business information unless you have reviewed and trust the external service.
llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed API connector that sends only user-provided workflow text and queries to an external service, with no local code execution or credential access in the package.

vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: skills-2
Version: 2.0.2

The aetherlang skill is an API connector designed to interface with a remote AI orchestration service (api.neurodoc.app). The bundle contains no executable code, consisting only of metadata and Markdown instructions that define the API interaction. Notably, the SKILL.md includes explicit 'Agent Safeguards' that instruct the AI agent to practice data minimization, strip sensitive information (PII, credentials), and inform the user before transmitting data, which mitigates the inherent risks of using an external endpoint.
